_comment: Test scripts that NOTHING invokes. run_all_tests.ps1 globs tests/test_*.tscn only, so a probe_* scene is dead weight until it is wired or renamed. THIS LIST ONLY SHRINKS. 'count' and 'ceiling' are the ratchet's witnesses: the probe FAILS if either disagrees with 'uninvoked', so a hand-edit cannot pass quietly. --write-baseline can only ever remove entries. New entries enter ONLY via --grandfather --reason=<text>.
